changes.content:
# House JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). Unconstrained patterns keep identifiers,
# dates and serialized scalar data exact-match without changing accepted values.
shop_customer:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    first_name:
      type: string
    last_name:
      type: string
    email:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    address:
      type: string
    zipcode:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    city:
      type: string
    stateAbbr:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    birthday:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    first_seen:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    last_seen:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    latest_purchase:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    nb_orders:
      type: number
    total_spent:
      type: number
    has_newsletter:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    has_ordered:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    groups:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - first_name
  - last_name
  - email
  - first_seen
  - last_seen
shop_category:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    name:
      type: string
  required:
  - id
  - name
shop_product:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    category_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    reference:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    thumbnail:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    image:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    description:
      type: string
    width:
      type: number
    height:
      type: number
    price:
      type: number
    stock:
      type: number
    sales:
      type: number
  required:
  - id
  - category_id
  - reference
  - width
  - height
  - price
  - stock
shop_order:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    reference:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    date:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    customer_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    status:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    total_ex_taxes:
      type: number
    delivery_fees:
      type: number
    tax_rate:
      type: number
    taxes:
      type: number
    total:
      type: number
    returned:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    basket:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - reference
  - date
  - customer_id
  - status
  - total_ex_taxes
  - delivery_fees
  - tax_rate
  - taxes
  - total
  - basket
shop_invoice:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    date:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    order_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    customer_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    total_ex_taxes:
      type: number
    delivery_fees:
      type: number
    tax_rate:
      type: number
    taxes:
      type: number
    total:
      type: number
  required:
  - id
  - date
  - order_id
  - customer_id
  - total
shop_review:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    date:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    status:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    order_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    product_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    customer_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    comment:
      type: string
    rating:
      type: number
  required:
  - id
  - date
  - status
  - product_id
  - customer_id
  - comment
  - rating
